description: The facility manager needs a central landing page to navigate between different energy systems. Update the 'Facility Overview' dashboard to include navigation links to the 'HVAC Detail', 'Lighting Detail', and 'Solar Detail' dashboards. 1. Find the Dashboard IDs for the three detail dashboards. 2. Edit the 'Facility Overview' dashboard. 3. Add widget(s) (Paragraph/Text) containing HTML links pointing to each detail dashboard (e.g., HVAC). 4. Save the dashboard.
